analysis: fresh C2 quasi-static multi-contact wrench allocation; conservative 64-sided inscribed Coulomb cones; no table or other support
friction_model: 64-sided inscribed cone; no torsional friction; per-contact Fn >= 0; exact static 6D equilibrium at bottle COM
objective: bisection on maximum per-contact normalized inscribed-cone utilization; secondary minimize total normal force at the optimal utilization

uncertainty_model.contact_point: each digit contact point shifted vertically by alternating +/-0.5 mm, with both alternating patterns tested
uncertainty_model.contact_normal: each local frame rigidly rotated by +/-1 degree toward world +Z or -Z
uncertainty_model.allocation_recourse: L1 change in all candidate local force components constrained to <=5% of the fresh candidate max-margin allocation L1 magnitude
uncertainty_model.driver_effort: official URDF source limits intersected with the unchanged 0.531 Nm SIMULATION_ONLY_M0 cap

classification_criterion: A requires every specified candidate-geometry uncertainty scenario feasible with an effort-minimized allocation constrained to <=0.90 maximum inscribed-cone utilization and <=0.531 Nm, <=5% L1 recourse from the fresh candidate max-margin allocation, and positive thumb plus opposing-digit support. B means the friction/uncertainty margin fails; C means the static effort margin is not demonstrated. This is an analysis screen, not a physical grasp acceptance gate.
